nodes.text:
An ordinal is a number in a sequence. That's all we ever were - the Throne counted us out and expected us back in order.

I kept the mending half of the litany. Come and be mended.

Out there, still being sung, by Ordinals who came back in order.

Pyre Ordinal, Ember Ordinal - they were my sequence. Same training, same words, and they finished the count. I stopped at mine. That is the entire difference between them and me.
